North India

Kashmir

Paradise on Earth, all four seasons of it

Plan My Kashmir TripView Packages
Best Time
March–October (Dec–Feb for snow)
Ideal Duration
5–7 days
Budget
₹18,000 – ₹45,000 per person for 5–6 days
State
Jammu & Kashmir

Overview

Snow-draped peaks, cedar forests, mirror-calm lakes and Mughal gardens — Kashmir is India's most storied Himalayan valley. Shikara rides on Dal Lake, gondola rides in Gulmarg and meadow walks in Pahalgam make it a year-round wonder.

Top Attractions

Dal Lake, Srinagar

Iconic lake with floating gardens, shikaras and houseboats.

Gulmarg Gondola

One of the world's highest cable cars up Apharwat Peak.

Pahalgam Valley

Betaab & Aru valleys, pine forests and the Lidder river.

Sonamarg

Meadow of gold — gateway to the Thajiwas glacier.

Mughal Gardens

Nishat, Shalimar and Chashme Shahi terraced gardens.

Old City, Srinagar

Jama Masjid, wooden architecture and saffron bazaars.

Things to Do

Shikara ride at sunrise
Gondola & snow sports in Gulmarg
Trout fishing in Pahalgam
Saffron & pashmina shopping
Wazwan feast
Photography walk in Old Srinagar

Travel Tips

  • •Carry photo ID; keep permits for Sonamarg/Gulmarg arranged by your hotel
  • •Book houseboats 2–3 weeks ahead in season
  • •Pack layers — evenings are cold even in summer
  • •Use Yatraa-verified cabs for mountain drives

How to Reach

By Air
Direct flights to Srinagar (SXR) from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Kolkata.
By Train
Nearest railhead: Jammu Tawi / Katra (SVDK), then a 7–8 hr scenic road drive.
By Road
Srinagar is 270 km from Jammu via the Jammu–Srinagar highway (NH-44).

Best Time to Visit

Spring (Mar–May)8–22°C

Almond blossoms and green meadows

Summer (Jun–Aug)15–30°C

Pleasant, best for families

Autumn (Sep–Nov)5–20°C

Golden chinar foliage

Winter (Dec–Feb)-4–10°C

Heavy snow, skiing season
